name: HVAC Chiller Inspection & Maintenance
summary:
HVAC Chiller Inspection & Maintenance is the official virtual reality training application for the ImmerseLearn HVAC Chiller Inspection & Maintenance Micro-Credential Program. Designed to complement instructor-led and online learning, this immersive simulation enables learners to develop practical chiller inspection and maintenance skills in a safe, interactive environment.
